candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Surface Model (DSM) - 2m
verified_facts: The 2m composite DSM includes object heights as well as terrain and is assembled from Time Stamped and National LIDAR Programme surveys.
The composite uses newest best-resolution survey data where repeats exist and may include resampling before merge.
semantic_limits: The 2m DSM is not a bare-earth terrain substitute and its composite lineage must be resolved before any parcel-level use.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite DTM 2017 - 25cm
verified_facts: The metadata record states the 25cm composite product is retired and no longer available on the Data Services Platform, and that it was replaced by a 1m composite product.
Historical 25cm time-stamped data remains available through the survey archive while the retired composite record documents its former production and accuracy context.
semantic_limits: A retired higher-resolution product must not be treated as the current canonical source merely because its nominal grid is finer; availability, survey date and product lifecycle must be verified.
